How it started.

The Magic led 34–27 after one quarter. At the half, the Magic led 57–52.

2 · The difference

Franz Wagner: a season-high 33

10 of 10 at the line, with 7 rebounds and 7 assists.

3 · How it turned

Up 5 at the half, and never behind after an 18–5 run in the second

Wagner and Black combined for 59 of 107.

4 · Where it was won

Won it in the paint and on turnovers

Points in the paint 58–28; turnovers forced 21–14. Orlando scored 33 points off 21 Sacramento turnovers.

Magic 107, Kings 100.

2 · The play of the game

Wagner from deep.

Franz Wagner's 3-pointer with 3:10 left in the second quarter that made it 52–43 and capped an 18–5 Orlando run; the Magic led the rest of the way.
